problem: Production pricing interaction proof timed out when attempting to click data-bg-stage=loss at 390px viewport.
root_cause: The six lifecycle choices were rendered in a horizontally scrollable single row on mobile. The second and later choices could be outside the initial visible interaction area, making the production contract non-deterministic even though the DOM nodes existed.
prevention: Primary pricing lifecycle choices must all be directly visible at mobile width without horizontal scrolling.
Use a two-column mobile grid with wrapped labels and minimum 48px touch targets.
Keep interaction verification on a 390x844 viewport and fail closed when a primary lifecycle option is not directly clickable.
Do not weaken the production verifier with force-click; fix the UI contract instead.
